description: Na₄UCr₃O₁₄ crystallizes in the triclinic P̅1 space group. There are four inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a 7-coordinate geometry to seven O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.42-2.64 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.42-2.77 Å. In the third Na site, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.34-2.93 Å. In the fourth Na site, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.39-2.69 Å. U is bonded to seven O atoms to form distorted UO₇ pentagonal bipyramids that share corners with five CrO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of U-O bond distances ranging from 1.83-2.41 Å. There are three inequivalent Cr sites. In the first Cr site, Cr is bonded to four O atoms to form CrO₄ tetrahedra that share  a cornercorner with one UO₇ pentagonal bipyramid. There are a spread of Cr-O bond distances ranging from 1.64-1.72 Å. In the second Cr site, Cr is bonded to four O atoms to form CrO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent UO₇ pentagonal bipyramids. There are a spread of Cr-O bond distances ranging from 1.63-1.71 Å. In the third Cr site, Cr is bonded to four O atoms to form CrO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent UO₇ pentagonal bipyramids. There are a spread of Cr-O bond distances ranging from 1.64-1.70 Å. There are fourteen inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a distorted single-bond geometry to one Na, one U, and one Cr atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to two Na and one Cr atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one U, and one Cr atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to two Na and one Cr atom. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to three Na and one Cr atom. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to two Na and one U atom. In the seventh O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to three Na and one Cr atom. In the eighth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one U, and one Cr atom. In the ninth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one U, and one Cr atom. In the tenth O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal planar geometry to two Na and one Cr atom. In the eleventh O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one U, and one Cr atom. In the twelfth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to two Na and one Cr atom. In the thirteenth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to two Na and one U atom. In the fourteenth O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal non-coplanar geometry to two Na and one Cr atom.
